B1.description: Conventional hybrid question-only RAG baseline (RS3 = B1, alpha=1, beta=0, gamma=0)

RS4.description: Recency-only: take top 50 by Rq, then sort by recency and select top-k

RS5.description: Status-filter-only: drop events whose Rt for the intent is <= 0.2, then rank by Rq

B3.description: Question + History relevance (Rq + Rh, gamma=0, per-intent tuned weights)

B2.description: Proposed Chronology-Aware Context Fusion (Rq + Rh + Rt, per-intent tuned weights, A2 flags)

B1+.description: B1 selection with A2 status, conflict, and uncertainty annotations

B2-.description: B2 selection with A0 (events only, no status or flag annotations)

B4.description: B2 selection with A1 (status annotations only, no conflict/uncertainty flags)

ORACLE-G.description: Gold events upper bound for generation (alias for ORACLE)
